people.name: Cynthia Kay Fick
people.bio_note: Founder, President, and majority owner, with 31+ years in finance and investing. Author of 'The Sisterhood of Money: The Art of Creating Wealth from Your Heart,' a narrative-style book built around the six-stage Financial Life Planning process she developed and taught to hundreds of women in seminars. Frequently featured in local media — The Arizona Republic, Ahwatukee Foothills News, and Phoenix-market TV shows — as a go-to voice on women and money.
people.bio_source: cpapracticeadvisor.com coverage of her book launch plus Amazon/Barnes & Noble listings for 'The Sisterhood of Money' (independent of the firm website)

people.name: Gina Giachetti Wight
people.bio_note: Partner and Co-Owner, Registered Investment Advisor with 15+ years in financial services. Prior to Financial Life Planners, she was Vice President, Branch Manager at Morgan Stanley. Holds Series 63 and 65 licenses and is registered to advise in Arizona, California, and Texas.
people.bio_source: financiallifeplanners.com team page (firm's own website states her prior Vice President, Branch Manager role at Morgan Stanley). Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): a ZoomInfo profile for her exists but could not be directly re-fetched to confirm this specific detail independently; treat as firm-stated.

firm_note.text: Financial Life Planners is a Tempe, AZ RIA founded in 2001 (some sources say 2003) serving roughly 298 client relationships. Co-owned by founder Cynthia Fick and partner Gina Giachetti Wight, both fiduciaries with 50+ combined years in the industry.
